name: North–South Tunnel Corridor
description: Construction of a 16.7 km six-lane twin-tube underground tunnel connecting Hebbal Junction to Silk Board Junction under the B-SMILE initiative.
location_name: Hebbal Junction to Silk Board Junction

name: East–West Tunnel Corridor
description: Proposed 22 km underground tunnel corridor connecting KR Puram and the Outer Ring Road area to Mysore Road, linking the Marathahalli and Kengeri corridors.

name: Citywide White-Topping Program
description: Large-scale concrete white-topping of approximately 450–500 km of major Bengaluru roads to improve road durability and reduce recurring maintenance.

name: Peripheral Ring Road (Bengaluru Business Corridor)
description: Proposed 73.03 km eight-lane access-controlled expressway connecting Tumkur Road, Bellary Road, Old Madras Road, Whitefield Road and Hosur Road around Bengaluru.
location_name: Tumkur Road to Hosur Road via Bellary Road and Old Madras Road

name: Hebbal–Mehkri Short Tunnel
description: Construction of a 2.2 km twin-bore cut-and-cover tunnel with three lanes in each direction under Ballari Road between Hebbal and the Mehkri area.
location_name: Hebbal to Mehkri Circle via Ballari Road

name: Hebbal–Mehkri Elevated Corridor
description: Construction of a 1.2 km elevated corridor with two lanes in each direction from UAS Staff Quarters to Mehkri Circle on Ballari Road, integrated with the Hebbal–Mehkri tunnel.
location_name: UAS Staff Quarters to Mehkri Circle

name: Old Madras Road–Electronic City Elevated Corridor
description: Construction of a 5.20 km elevated highway connecting Old Madras Road near KR Puram to Electronic City via Indiranagar, Airport Road and Hosur Road using ultra-high-performance concrete.
location_name: Old Madras Road to Electronic City

name: Phase-1: 11 Elevated Corridors
description: Umbrella B-SMILE program comprising 11 elevated corridors totaling approximately 75.6 km across major Bengaluru arterial roads, including Tumkur Road, Kanakapura Road and Hosur Road.
